title: Vijay Kumar Agrawal v. State of U.P.
coram: Dilip B. Bhosale, C.J. and Suneet Kumar, J.
disposition: Petition not pressed; liberty to complain under Supply Code 6.5.
headnote: Writ over disputed electricity bills disposed of as not pressed, with liberty to make a complaint under clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Merits not examined.
facts: Vijay Kumar Agrawal filed Writ-C No. 19736 of 2018 in the Allahabad High Court against the State of Uttar Pradesh and four others in a dispute over electricity bills. Counsel for respondent no. 2 and for respondents 4 and 5 appeared. At the hearing, the petitioner's counsel did not press the writ and sought liberty to make a complaint under clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 seeking correction of the bills in dispute.

holding_units.holding: The writ petition, seeking correction of disputed electricity bills, was not pressed. Liberty was granted to the petitioner to make a complaint under clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The Court recorded that it had not examined the merits.

not_decided.point: Merits of the disputed electricity bills
not_decided.note: The Court expressly recorded that it had not examined the merits while granting liberty to complain under clause 6.5.
